title: Free Add-ons (Added Value Services)
description: Free extras each insurer includes with its individual life, critical illness and income protection policies, such as a remote GP, second medical opinions and nurse support.
status: Draft from insurer announcements and comparison sites. These services are non-contractual, so insurers can change or withdraw them at any time. Check the insurer's current added value page before telling a client about them.

insurers.name: Aviva

values.gp: Unlimited digital GP, 24/7, 365 days a year (from 29 Jan 2026)
values.mental: Up to 8 mental health sessions a year
values.nurse: Up to 8 bereavement support sessions a year
values.other: Up to 8 nutrition sessions and up to 8 online personal training sessions a year. Finger-prick health check now costs £39.95 (was free).
values.family: Policyholder, partner and children up to 18 (21 in full-time education) for the digital GP

insurers.notes: Services are non-contractual and Aviva can change them.

values.gp: Unlimited GP by phone or video, 24/7, from anywhere in the world
values.physio: Phone consultations for aches and pains
values.second_opinion: Face-to-face second opinion from a UK consultant if diagnosed with a life-changing or life-threatening condition
values.nurse: Personal nurse adviser alongside the second opinion
values.family: Policyholder and immediate family (children covered too where Children's Critical Illness Protection is held)

insurers.name: Legal & General

values.nurse: Wellbeing Support from RedArc registered nurses: illness, injury, bereavement, mental health, treatment options and understanding a diagnosis
values.other: Care Concierge: help finding and arranging later-life care (policies from 20 July 2023). Rehabilitation Support Services on income protection.

insurers.notes: Comparison sites say L&G has no remote GP on individual policies (its virtual GP is for group customers only). Paid-for Fracture Cover and Private Diagnostics were withdrawn in 2024–25.

insurers.name: LV=

values.gp: Unlimited remote GP, 24/7, by video or phone
values.physio: Up to 5 remote physiotherapy sessions with a treatment plan
values.second_opinion: UK specialist, by video or face to face

insurers.notes: Only for certain policies bought after 2017. Check whether the session limits are per year.

values.gp: Virtual GP, 24/7, by phone or video (HealthHero)
values.mental: Mental health support, e.g. CBT; sessions set by the nurse based on clinical need
values.physio: Physiotherapy; sessions set by the nurse based on clinical need
values.second_opinion: Face-to-face second opinion in the UK, without needing to claim
values.nurse: Dedicated RedArc nurse for practical and emotional support, for as long as needed
values.other: Speech therapy and other therapies where the nurse arranges them
values.family: Plan owner, partner and children (virtual GP covers dependent children up to 16)

insurers.name: Scottish Widows

values.gp: Remote GP 24/7 with prescription delivery (Clinic in a Pocket app, Square Health)
values.second_opinion: Face-to-face second opinion from UK specialists, arranged by the personal nurse
values.nurse: Dedicated RedArc personal nurse by phone, for as long as needed
values.other: Nutrition support; complementary and occupational therapy via the nurse

insurers.notes: Session limits not published in the sources found. Check the adviser added value page.

insurers.name: The Exeter

values.gp: GP on demand by phone or video, with prescriptions
values.other: Income protection: up to 6 dietitian and 6 nutritionist consultations a year. Life plans: nutrition advice and lifestyle coaching.

insurers.notes: Using HealthWise isn't a claim, so it doesn't affect no-claims discounts.

insurers.name: Vitality

values.other: Rewards and discounts for staying active: Apple Watch deal, gym discounts, Caffè Nero and other partner rewards (better rewards with Optimiser / Vitality Plus). Healthy habits can lower premiums.

insurers.notes: Vitality GP comes with Vitality health insurance, not life cover. Some rewards need a minimum premium and Optimiser (an extra monthly cost).

insurers.name: Zurich

values.nurse: 24/7 access to counsellors and advisers throughout the policy, not only at claim
values.other: Optional paid add-on Zurich Accelerate (£9.50 a month): virtual consultations, private diagnostics, second opinions and cancer treatment support. It isn't free.

insurers.notes: Zurich's ZGP24 virtual GP is confirmed for group protection only. Sources are unclear whether individual policyholders get a free GP. Check with Zurich.
